vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: junli-ai-novel
Version: 0.1.2

The bundle is a comprehensive AI-driven workflow for writing long-form web novels. It includes a suite of Python scripts (e.g., chapter_pipeline.py, new_project.py, extract_thrills.py) designed to manage local project structures, track writing progress, and perform text analysis for genre-specific elements like word counts, emotional curves, and common tropes. The instructions in SKILL.md and the extensive reference documentation are strictly aligned with the creative writing process and contain no evidence of malicious prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized system access. All file operations are localized to the project directory, and no suspicious network activity or obfuscation was detected.

llm.summary: The skill's files and runtime instructions are consistent with a local novel project workflow: it reads and updates project files, offers scaffolding and checks, and does not request credentials or perform network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (long-form web-novel workflow: init, resume, write, check, memory recovery) matches the included scripts and reference docs. All requested resources (none) and declared behavior align with a local manuscript/outline management tool.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the bundled Python scripts which read and write files inside a project directory (docs/, manuscript/, plot/, task_log.md). This is expected for the stated purpose, but the scripts can modify files under any project path you supply — ensure you point them at the intended project directory.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec; the skill is instruction-and-script based. There are only plain Python scripts and markdown references packaged with the skill — nothing is downloaded or executed from external URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. All file access is local and limited to the project structure described in SKILL.md, which is proportionate to its purpose.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a self-contained local workflow for planning and checking serialized novels. It reads and writes files in whatever project directory you give it (creates docs/, manuscript/, plot/, task_log.md, etc.). It does not request network access or secrets. Before running, verify the project_path you pass to commands to avoid accidental modification of unrelated directories, and review the bundled Python scripts if you want to confirm behavior (they perform local file I/O and text analysis only).
